internal.title: Incident Resolved: Checkout Service High Error Rate Due to Payment Service Error Injection
internal.body:
At 10:19 UTC, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Diagnosis identified the root cause as an error injection in the payment service, specifically the paymentFailure flag causing failed card charges due to invalid tokens. The error rate in checkout peaked at 47.5%. The flag was disabled at 10:39 UTC after approval, leading to a rapid recovery with error rates returning to normal levels (around 0.2%). The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact observed.

Key timeline:
- 10:19:43: Alert received for high error rate in checkout
- 10:39:27: Diagnosis confirmed paymentFailure flag in payment service as cause
- 10:39:33: Flag disabled after approval
- 10:39:33: Recovery verified with normalized error rates

Other services such as cart and ad were investigated but found not to be contributing significantly to the issue.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment processing errors
external.body: Between 10:19 and 10:39 UTC, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to payment processing errors. Our team identified the cause and resolved the issue by disabling a problematic payment feature. Checkout service error rates have returned to normal, and the service is operating normally. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
